textHelp.title: {{archetype.plugin.name}}
textHelp.paragraph1: This plugin is a sample template to create new external plugins on API-IDEE v2 with SidePanel.
textHelp.paragraph2: Open the panel from the side button, check the sample content and use it as a base for your own plugin (facade, control, styles and i18n).
textHelp.screenshot2Alt: {{archetype.plugin.name}} plugin panel open with sample content
textHelp.screenshot2Description: Expand the side panel to see the sample content. Replace templates, styles and icons when creating your plugin.
